what: Prompt R3c (2026-11-16): every change to a NORMAL turn's tool list since fixture v7 (4eefdb0): one tool added (captain_pick, before search_news, which stays last) and six changed. Undoing the list on v8's tools gives v7's byte for byte (Tests/test_agent_payload_equivalence.py). A draft chat's turn keeps prompts/draft_frozen/tools.json.

changes.why: item 1: the captain answer, written by code (a new tool, before search_news)

tool_json.name: captain_pick
tool_json.description: The captain answer for the user's OWN line-up, written by code: the pick and his predicted points for the gameweek with and without the armband, the line-up's top five captain options (predicted points, likely range, chance of starting, chance of playing 60+ minutes, fixture, FPL's flag), what captaining the pick over the next option is worth, the vice-captain, and the biggest part of the pick's prediction. Its text is shown to the user as the reply, so write nothing of your own. Use it for EVERY captain or vice-captain question about the user's team: 'who should I captain', 'who gets the armband', 'X or Y as captain', 'X or Y for captain', 'should I captain X or Y', 'is Haaland the right captain' -- never compare_predictions or compare_players for these. Pass the players the user names in player_ids (ids from resolve_player; up to three of their own fifteen). Optional gw for another gameweek of the run's horizon (a planning view). A result that is an error or the no-squad note carries no code-built text: answer it yourself.

player_ids.description: Optional: the players the user named for the armband (element ids, at most three)

gw.description: Optional gameweek of the run's horizon (default: the next deadline's)
